'''Steven Howard''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[April 2001 Pleasanton tournament (14 April)]] on 14 April 2001 with [[You Can Either Profit By This... / Or Be Destroyed|Profit (only starts Squassin)]], according to Michael Mendoza's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2081">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-15-i-hate-taxes-in-ca-4-41-01d2081/ i-hate-taxes-in-ca-4-41-01], DeckTech (Michael "Longshot" Mendoza, 15 April 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-15-i-hate-taxes-in-ca-4-41-01d2081/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
